lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 8 distinct vertical white lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is widest in the central abdominal region and becomes more compressed toward the posterior and anterior margins.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most line segment is abbreviated, terminating mid-flank. The anterior-most line near the shoulder is faded and does not reach the ventral line.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit an initial vertical and lateral outward spiral from the base, transitioning into a posterior-medial lyrate curvature toward the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 3.8 times the pixel width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 10-12% of the total longitudinal length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: White V-shaped chevron between the eyes; two high-contrast white spots on the lower cheek; white dorsal fringe/crest; bright ochre-orange lower limbs with a distinct white transverse band above the carpal and tarsal joints.
